topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes and outlines the expected learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages to evolving clones.

topics.label: Cancer stem cells and cell of origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the cancer stem cell model and present experimental evidence demonstrating how cellular hierarchy and the cell of origin influence tumor development.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal dependency
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how environmental promoters, chronic inflammation, and supportive stroma cooperate with mutations to facilitate tumor progression.

topics.label: Methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the experimental and computational technologies used to investigate tumor heterogeneity, cellular plasticity, and spatial microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Integrative synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic mutations, cell-of-origin properties, epigenetic states, and microenvironmental factors combine to drive cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
